newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Fogade sells 2 bolsa seats for $1.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Fogade sells 2 bolsa seats for $1.2 mln.

text.p: Venezuelan State Deposits Guarantee Fund Fogade auctioned two seats on the Caracas stock exchange for a total of 548 million bolivars ($1.2 million), outstripping the 300 million bolivar base price, Fogade said.
Seat 30 was sold for 257 million bolivars to investor Wilmer Leonel Estrada Ruiz and Seat 48 was sold for 291 million bolivars to Accival brokers.

Fogade sold two seats on the exchange for a total of 400 million bolivars ($860,000) on September 26. The sales are part of Fogade's program to sell off assets it received in exchange for financial aid during the 1994-5 financial crisis.
